title: Derived pullback of a complex coproduct and its translate
statement: Let f : Z → Y be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with module derived categories in a common morphism universe [def-pc-derived-category], and let E_n be any countable family of cochain complexes of O_Y-module sheaves [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Write q for the homotopy quotient and L=Q_Y⋙Lf* [def-pc-derived-pullback]. The cofan with vertex L(q(⊕ E_n)) and legs L(q(ι_n)) is a coproduct. The cofan with vertex L(q(⊕ E_n)[1]) and legs L(q(ι_n)[1]) is also a coproduct. There is no boundedness, flatness, properness, or Noetherian hypothesis.

source.place: Explicit complex-coproduct proof using K-injective representatives, followed by derived-adjunction preservation; normalization expansion step 1.

proof.text: The sheaf-module category is Grothendieck abelian and has AB4 in universe u. Transport exact coproducts indexed by ULift J along its discrete equivalence with J to obtain CountableAB4 explicitly. Apply the already-proved isColimit_mapCocone_countableSum of lem-kun-derived-countable-sums-exact to E. The explicit degreewise complex cocone is a colimit, so Q preserves this diagram. Consequently the chosen complex coproduct, with exactly Q of its coprojections, is a coproduct in the derived category. The Qh carrier and cofan families are explicit to avoid costly model inference; these annotations preserve the original elaborated statement.

Derived pullback is a left adjoint, hence preserves that coproduct. Transport along quotientCompQhIso. For the translated cofan, use the natural Qh shift comparison and preservation of coproducts by the derived shift equivalence, then apply derived pullback again.

lean.statement:
theorem flat_telescope_pullback_sum_colimit
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Z ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (E : ℕ → CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) :
    let q := HomotopyCategory.quotient
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    let L := DerivedCategory.Qh
      (C := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ⋙ derivedPullback f
    Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk (f := fun n ↦ L.obj (q.obj (E n)))
      (L.obj (q.obj (∐ E)))
      (fun n ↦ L.map (q.map (Sigma.ι E n))))) ∧
    Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk (f := fun n ↦ L.obj ((q.obj (E n))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧))
      (L.obj ((q.obj (∐ E))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧))
      (fun n ↦ L.map ((q.map (Sigma.ι E n))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧'))))
